contamination_reason: Measured a superseded benchmark. Two spec defects were found by analysing these runs: (a) two subjects shared the shipping_delay signal, so "Customer 003s shipping ticket" had two correct answers; (b) multi_ticket_conditional required only priority while the prompt told the agent to apply policies that also mandate escalation and team. Fixed in fixture v5 / tasks v4; suite hash and turn budget both changed.
detection_mechanism: analyze_p3_baseline taxonomy: 4 tasks failing 10/10 with a single repeated signature, then trajectory inspection
why_retained: Deleting a contaminated run hides how the contamination happened. The data is unusable; the evidence is not.
